High-level items I pulled out from the call: 

- Success criteria: 95% intent coverage on the pilot prompt set; P95 latency < 350ms for 1k daily concurrent tokens.
- Evaluation scope: Chat flows + 2 embeddings batch jobs for search relevance.
- Proposed owners: Priya (Acme)  evaluation lead; Marissa (Redwood)  technical enablement; Aditya (Redwood)  security & infra checklist.
- Proposed timeline: Kickoff next week (Mar 29) -> 2-week evaluation window -> decision meeting Apr 12.

Could you confirm the owner assignments and whether the timeline works for you? If Priya is the evaluation owner we can set calendar invites and Ill share the test prompt set and short onboarding playbook up front.

If anything here is off, let me know and Ill update the MAP. Looking forward to getting the pilot scheduled.
